# Zevston

> Zevston is a company in Lahore, Pakistan that offers construction (civil engineering) and interior design with custom woodwork under one team, so a project can go from foundation to final finish without hiring two companies.

Website: https://zevston.com/
Location: DHA Phase 5, Lahore, Pakistan
Phone: 0333 4434464, 0304 7676222
Email: contact@zevston.com
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923334434464

## About

Zevston was founded by two brothers, who are its co-founders and each lead one division. Figures below are as stated on the website: 150+ completed projects, 120+ clients served, 13 years of experience, 50+ team members.

- Muhammad Imran Kabeer, Co-Founder: leads civil engineering and construction (project planning, site supervision, structural coordination, cost management). https://zevston.com/imran-kabeer/
- Muhammad Jabran Kabeer, Co-Founder: leads interiors, woodwork and décor (space planning, décor, custom furniture, kitchens, wardrobes, office interiors). https://zevston.com/jabran-kabeer/

## Services

Civil engineering and construction: residential construction, commercial construction, project management, sustainable building.
Interior design and woodwork: interior design and space planning, custom woodwork and furniture, kitchens and wardrobes, office interiors.

## How to request a quote

Use the quote form at https://zevston.com/#quote (it opens WhatsApp or email with the details filled in), message on WhatsApp, or email contact@zevston.com.
